csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Westerly, acting through its Purchasing Agent, is hereby soliciting sealed Request for Qualifications from individuals for a Plumbing and Mechanical Inspector. Position: Job Description: The Plumbing / Mechanical Inspector shall be responsible for inspections of all new installations in all new construction, alterations, or renovations to ensure compliance with State Code. This may include trenches, interior and exterior plumbing, heating, air conditioning and exterior equipment. Also performs inspections for business licenses as required by State Law. Schedule agreed upon by the Inspector and the Building Official.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering
